mapper.sql: id, feedback_id, base_id, user_id, session_id, message_id, trace_id, answer_log_id, question, answer, feedback_type, feedback_content, policy_key, policy_name, topic_type, question_type, evidence_ids, evidence_source, route_plan, validation_summary, status, priority, handler_id, handle_result, handled_at, created_at, updated_at

WHERE 1 = 1
AND status = #{request.status}
AND feedback_type = #{request.feedbackType}
AND policy_key ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.policyKey}, '%')
AND topic_type ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.topicType}, '%')
AND ( question ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR answer ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR feedback_content ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR policy_key ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') OR policy_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{request.keyword}, '%') )
AND created_at >= CAST(#{request.startTime} AS timestamp)
AND created_at <= CAST(#{request.endTime} AS timestamp)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_policy_feedback_task ( feedback_id, base_id, user_id, session_id, message_id, trace_id, answer_log_id, question, answer, feedback_type, feedback_content, policy_key, policy_name, topic_type, question_type, evidence_ids, evidence_source, route_plan, validation_summary, status, priority, handler_id, handle_result, handled_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{feedbackId}, #{baseId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{traceId}, #{answerLogId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{feedbackType}, #{feedbackContent}, #{policyKey}, #{policyName}, #{topicType}, #{questionType}, #{evidenceIds}, #{evidenceSource}, #{routePlan}, #{validationSummary}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{handlerId}, #{handleResult}, #{handledAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ai_policy_feedback_task
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_policy_feedback_task SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, handled_at = CASE WHEN #{markHandled} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE handled_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
